"""O3 of the N12 lot 3c-2b note: an AMR checkpoint written by the tag-graph route before it went.

Run at commit c1a3369d6 (the first commit of 3c-2b, which still has the graph), from the repository
root: python3.12 produce.py tests/python/data/amr_graph_checkpoint.npz. The case is the ``value``
case of test_refinement_criterion_parity.py, written on the graph route, stepped once.
"""
import sys

import pops
from pops.amr import Coarsen, Tag
from pops.math import ValueExpr
from tests.python.integration.amr.test_refinement_criterion_parity import THRESHOLDS
from tests.python.support.refinement_criterion_cases import T_END, advection_case


def rules(names):
    value = ValueExpr(names.state)
    return (Tag(value > names.value("value_refine")),
            Coarsen(value < names.value("value_coarsen")))


case, layout, _ = advection_case(rules, thresholds=THRESHOLDS, name="refinement_criterion_parity")
runtime = pops.bind(pops.compile(pops.resolve(pops.validate(case), layout=layout)))
pops.step(runtime, t_bound=T_END)
runtime.checkpoint(sys.argv[1])
print("levels", runtime.n_levels(), "time", runtime.time(), "macro_step", runtime.macro_step())
